t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Prioritise responding within the time. Pink and purple worked best for the last participant, but if this isn't the case for me, try a different strategy.

vb_textbox.text: Prioritise responding on time, go with your gut. I found that yellow, red and blue often got me the most mushrooms, but I cannot be sure that it is like this in every round. Try to find patterns of your own if this isn't the case for you.
